group.label: Banner Images
group.comment: Applies to every banner. Size and aspect ratio are set on each banner (Content → Banners). Changing these regenerates the images on the next page view.

field.label: Image Quality
field.comment: 40–95. 75–82 is usually indistinguishable from the original at a fraction of the size.

field.label: Also Serve WebP
field.comment: Browsers that support WebP (all current ones) get it, typically 25–35% smaller; the others get JPEG/PNG. Ignored if the server's PHP can't write WebP.
